text_block_list.text:
It's the morning of the JBC Classic, and
Smart
Falcon has something she wants to
do on the way
to the racecourse...

It's been pretty chilly lately, don't you
think? But
I've got just the thing to keep
out the cold. ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The JBC Classic! ☆ There's nothing like
a heated
race on the dirt to warm you
right up! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Please come and watch!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Come see me again sometime!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
For handing out flyers with me! I
planned to do
this by myself, but you
went out of your way to
help!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Since I've gotten so much stronger, I
wanted to
do everything I can to get
people to watch.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
All right! ☆ Let's hand out as many as we
can with
the time we have!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Well, no matter, what we'll still have a few—scratch that—tons left over...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you Смарт Фалкон, by any
chance?
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, yes, that's me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Pigs can't fly, but my pigtails will fly me
to my
dreams. ☆ Leading the pack in
cuteness, I'm the
one and only Falco! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yay! I saw you perform! You've been
working
really hard recently! I'll be
rooting you on. And I'll
take one of
those flyers, please!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'll take one too! I've heard things are
really
starting to heat up in the dirt
races.
text_block_list.name: Passerby C

text_block_list.text:
I don't have any plans today, so I might
as well go
watch.
text_block_list.name: Passerby D

text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I'm so happy to hear that. ☆ I'll
be waiting
for you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What's all the hubbub? ...The JBC
Classic?
text_block_list.name: Passerby E

text_block_list.text: Some time later...

We gave out all the flyers... It's like a
dream come
true...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Things are starting to liven up!

text_block_list.text: You think so too? It's not just me?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Смарт Фалкон! Good luck today!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: I'll be cheering for you!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Th-thanks! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Wow, look at all these people...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Looks like the word is out. Everyone's
realizing
just how fun dirt races are.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...And that means I can't afford to let
them down
today.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's my duty to put on a good race and
top it off
with a super awesome concert!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
